{
  "name": "cache-keeper",
  "version": "0.4.3",
  "description": "Keeps the main conversation's prompt cache warm while you are away, within a window you choose, and shows its state above the prompt.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Aditya Parab"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/parab-aditya/cache-keeper",
  "repository": "https://github.com/parab-aditya/cache-keeper",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "prompt-cache",
    "cache",
    "keep-warm",
    "usage",
    "cost",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "keepFor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Keep the cache warm for",
      "description": "How long the cache is kept warm after your last message, once you turn warming on (every session starts off).",
      "default": "8h",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "2h",
        "4h",
        "8h",
        "12h",
        "forever"
      ]
    },
    "lead": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refresh this many minutes before expiry",
      "description": "Applies to the 1-hour cache; the 5-minute cache is refreshed 30 seconds before expiry.",
      "default": "5",
      "options": [
        "2",
        "3",
        "5",
        "10",
        "15"
      ]
    },
    "minTokens": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Skip contexts smaller than",
      "description": "Tokens in the prompt below which refreshing costs more than rewriting would.",
      "default": "30000",
      "options": [
        "10000",
        "30000",
        "50000",
        "100000"
      ]
    },
    "weeklyGuard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stop at weekly usage %",
      "description": "Warming stops once your weekly plan usage reaches this percent.",
      "default": "90",
      "options": [
        "50",
        "75",
        "80",
        "90",
        "95",
        "100"
      ]
    },
    "band": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Band above the prompt",
      "description": "full shows state, savings and buttons; minimal a short line; off hides it.",
      "default": "full",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "minimal",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "upgradeTo1h": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Use the 1-hour cache on API-key sessions",
      "description": "Sets CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL=1h for this process when the 5-minute cache would otherwise apply.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ]
    }
  }
}
